title: VVnT SeQuor: Enterprise Digital Capability Partner & Overview
content: VVnT SeQuor is an AI-powered digital engineering firm and capability partner led by industry veterans with over 25 years of experience. We build inclusive, resilient, and high-performing digital ecosystems. Motto: Effectiveness In{Quality Security}. We make digital services faster, safer, and accessible to everyone. Our capabilities span AI-Driven Solutions, Custom Software Development, GenAI & Agentic AI, End-to-End Verification, Validation & Testing (VVNT Converge), Cybersecurity (3PAA/VAPT), Accessibility (WCAG), DevSecOps, and Managed IT Support.

title: Multifaceted Talent Pool & Industry Certifications
content: VVnT SeQuor features a team of ~45 Practitioners with 220+ years of collective experience. Over 70% of engineers are AI & Automation Savvy certified. Experience breakdown: 15+ years (6), 8+ years (8), 5+ years (6), 2+ years (16), <2 years (10). Tech Stack: UI/UX & Frontend (JavaScript, ReactJS, Angular), Backend & DB (Python, NodeJS, Java, SpringBoot, DotNet, MySQL). Certifications held: ISTQB Certified Digital QA, Certified Cloud & CyberSecurity Practitioner (CCSP, CCSK), DevSecOps Certified Practitioners, ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 20000 Certified, ITIL v3, Certified Kaizen & Continuous Improvement, Certified GDPR Practitioner & Fellow of Privacy Technology, Certified DevOps Leader & Enterprise Coach.

title: Large-Scale Skill Development & AI Trainings (Skill India)
content: Empowering next-generation youth with expert-led training in AI, Cloud, DevOps, Cyber Security, and Privacy to bridge the digital talent gap. Programs for 11th/12th graders and graduates cover GenAI, safe coding, and digital ethics, directly supporting the 'Skill India' mission. National Impact: Partnering with state and national education boards to implement Skill India initiatives, training thousands of students simultaneously.

title: GenAI & Agentic AI Development
content: We deploy autonomous AI agents and Consolidated Reporting Systems to automate complex tasks and ensure fiscal transparency in government budgeting. Our AI-driven Public Complaint systems analyze multi-lingual grievances to identify trends and recommend actions. Policy Intelligence tools forecast outcomes for data-driven decisions. Citizen AI Assistants streamline access to laws and public services. National Impact: Agentic AI solutions acting as digital co-pilots helping citizens navigate laws and entitlements in local languages.

title: Custom Software & Application Modernization (DigiYatra)
content: We modernize legacy applications into secure, AI-integrated platforms through Smart Governance Modules. Solutions include localized citizen portals, automated workflows, and dashboards for monitoring public works and grievances. We specialize in high-traffic infrastructure—such as examination portals—and biometric services like Face Recognition (e.g., DigiYatra) to ensure seamless, transparent identity verification. National Impact: Transforming fragmented systems into unified, interoperable digital ecosystems.

title: Cybersecurity & Privacy Assessments (VAPT & 3PAA)
content: Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT), Third-Party Assessment & Audits (3PAA) across cloud, mobile, and web. DevSecOps integration, strict compliance with DPDPA (2023), GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, PCI DSS, CIS, MITRE, OWASP, SANS. Implementation of WAF, DAM, Application Shielding & RASP tools. National Impact: Protecting national data (such as Aadhaar or health records) and securing critical infrastructure against cyber-attacks.

title: Accessibility & Inclusive Engineering (WCAG)
content: Ensuring technology works for everyone, including people with disabilities, by strictly adhering to WCAG, Section 508, and ADA standards to eliminate digital barriers. We perform accessibility audits, VPAT report creation, and inclusive UI/UX engineering. National Impact: Making 'Digital India' truly inclusive by ensuring all government websites and services are fully usable by every citizen regardless of physical abilities.

title: Strategic IT & Enterprise Architecture Advisory (Smart City)
content: Expert consulting and advisory services for government and enterprise leaders to design future-ready 'Smart City' architectures and manage large-scale digital transformations. Building long-term technology roadmaps to help officials align on complex IT infrastructure and ensure systems are scalable, interoperable, and resilient.

title: End-to-End IT Solutions, Infrastructure & User Enablement
content: Mission-critical IT solutions, including hardware procurement (servers, workstations, and CCTV/surveillance systems) alongside 24/7 technical support (L1/L2). Full-lifecycle maintenance for Cloud, On-Premise, and security infrastructure. National Impact: Ensuring essential services, from emergency response and surveillance to utility billing, remain online and secure 24/7.

title: AI-Driven Quality Assurance & Testing (VVNT Converge)
content: 360-degree testing coverage—functional, security, performance, UAT, observability, globalization/localization, reverse engineering, and continuous testing using our proprietary platform: VVNT Converge. Processes align with STQC standards to guarantee zero-failure reliability for high-traffic public portals like exam results or benefit registrations when millions of citizens access them simultaneously.

title: Techno-Legal Assurance & Auditing
content: Compliance audits ensuring regulatory adherence to global standards, Privacy Framework Compliance (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, DPDPA 2023), Accessibility Standards & Audits (WCAG, Section 508, ADA), Technology & Security Policy Audits, and Security Awareness & Training. Specialized auditing for AI, Blockchain, IoT, and Cloud.

title: Application Service Desk Solutions (L1/L2 Support)
content: Tier 1 (L1) and Tier 2 (L2) Advanced Support, Multi-channel assistance, Intelligent Ticket Management, SLA Tracking & Proactive Monitoring, Proactive Root Cause Analysis, and Disaster Recovery Planning Support. Customized support plans tailored to client needs.
